tools.name: ghn_list_provinces
tools.description: List all provinces and cities with their ProvinceID. Use the ProvinceID with ghn_list_districts. Uses the district address model. GHN: GET /master-data/province.

tools.name: ghn_list_districts
tools.description: List the districts of one province with DistrictID and service support (SupportType: 0 locked, 1 pickup only, 2 delivery only, 3 both). GHN: GET /master-data/district?province_id=.

tools.name: ghn_list_wards
tools.description: List the wards of one district. Use WardCode (a string) for ghn_calculate_fee and ghn_create_order ward fields. GHN: GET /master-data/ward?district_id=.

tools.name: ghn_list_services
tools.description: List the delivery services GHN offers on a route for this shop. Returns service_type_id (2 = under 20 kg, 5 = 20 kg or more or multi-parcel). Call it before ghn_calculate_fee. GHN: POST /v2/shipping-order/available-services.

tools.name: ghn_calculate_fee
tools.description: Quote the shipping fee for a parcel to a ward, before creating an order. Quote only: no order is created. GHN: POST /v2/shipping-order/fee.

tools.name: ghn_get_order
tools.description: Get the full details of one shipping order by its GHN tracking code: status, parties, COD, fees and items. GHN: GET /v2/shipping-order/detail?order_code=.

tools.name: ghn_get_order_by_client_code
tools.description: Get the full details of one shipping order by your own client_order_code instead of the GHN tracking code. GHN: GET /v2/shipping-order/detail-by-client-code?client_order_code=.

tools.name: ghn_create_order
tools.description: CREATES A REAL SHIPPING ORDER: GHN picks up and delivers the parcel and can charge the shop or collect cash on delivery (COD) from the recipient. tools.name: ghn_cancel_orders
tools.description: CANCELS REAL SHIPPING ORDERS. The batch is all-or-nothing: one unknown or foreign order code cancels nothing. Call only after the user explicitly confirms the order codes. An order that can no longer be cancelled returns result false. GHN: POST /v2/switch-status/cancel.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ghn_list_services · Public sink: ghn_list_services, ghn_calculate_fee, ghn_create_order, ghn_cancel_orders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ghn_list_services · Public sink: ghn_list_services, ghn_calculate_fee, ghn_create_order, ghn_cancel_orders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
